span.label: mechanisms
span.term: faster forgetting in infancy strips away the idiosyncratic details of individual experiences, so what accumulates is a general, fuzzy representation of the commonalities
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: immature selective attention leaves children unable to filter their input, which widens the pool of structure available for statistical learning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: attention gates statistical learning in adults, so a narrower adult attentional focus means less input is eligible to be learned at any moment
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: children's distributed attention makes them sample many structures at once, trading speed of learning any single structure for knowledge of relationships between structures
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the early-maturing monosynaptic hippocampal pathway extracts regularities across many similar experiences and therefore yields fuzzy rather than specific representations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: prior knowledge blocks learning of conflicting structure, so accumulated experience narrows what a learner can pick up

span.label: The paper's proposed developmental account is speculative and not yet tested.
span.note: what this limits: the developmental account offered in the discussion: IT IS LARGELY SPECULATIVE AND REMAINS TO BE TESTED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The developmental neuroimaging base is too thin to support conclusions about shifting neural substrates.
span.note: what this limits: any claim about shifting neural substrates: A CONFIDENT APPRAISAL OF POTENTIAL DEVELOPMENTAL SHIFTS IN THE NEURAL STRUCTURES THAT ARE INVOLVED IN STATISTICAL LEARNING CANNOT BE MADE FROM JUST TWO STUDIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The developmental timelines invoked come from animal histology and general memory research, not from human statistical-learning data.
span.note: what this limits: the developmental timelines the argument uses: MUCH OF THE DATA ON THESE EXACT TIMELINES COME FROM HISTOLOGICAL STUDIES IN ANIMALS AND BEHAVIOURAL HUMAN MEMORY DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH, SO THESE POSSIBILITIES FOR STATISTICAL LEARNING REQUIRE CONFIRMATION IN HUMAN INFANTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The review adopts one of two competing conceptualizations of its subject and says which it rejects.
span.note: what this limits: any finding reported in this review: the authors reject the conceptualization of statistical learning as a singular and inherently implicit system in favour of a set of learning processes, some of which can result in conscious access to learning
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A category boundary is drawn by how the excluded thing is typically assessed.
span.note: what this limits: the scope of statistical learning as used here: motor-based skill learning, such as serial reaction time tasks, is excluded because it is typically assessed in tasks that provide external feedback, so the boundary follows the assessment method rather than the phenomenon
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The quantity being compared across ages may itself differ by age.
span.note: what this limits: any developmental comparison of statistical learning: the authors state it likely changes in quality with age, operating over different sources of data and producing different representations
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: statistical learning - STIPULATED IN A BOX, WITH AN ADDED REQUIREMENT: defined as the learning of structure from repeated exposure to environmental statistics, with the further requirement that learning occur without reinforcement or external feedback - so the absence of feedback is part of the definition rather than a feature of the phenomenon
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: statistical learning - A SET OF PROCESSES, NOT A SINGLE IMPLICIT SYSTEM: the review names the rival conceptualization - a singular and inherently implicit learning system - and takes the other, under which some of the processes can result in conscious access; whether the term denotes one thing or several decides whether results from different tasks can be pooled
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the exclusion of skill learning - A BOUNDARY MADE OF AN ASSAY: motor-based skill learning is put outside the category because it is TYPICALLY ASSESSED in tasks that provide external feedback, so the same phenomenon assessed without feedback would fall inside, and the hedge 'typically' is the authors' own

span.label: Indirect measures such as saccade latency and neural entrainment show essentially no developmental change in statistical learning.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Direct measures such as two-alternative forced-choice tests do show age-related improvement, so the answer to whether statistical learning develops depends on how it is measured.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The improvement with age is domain-specific: visual and non-linguistic auditory statistical learning improve across childhood while learning of aurally presented syllables does not.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The review's central synthesis is that the format of what is learned changes with age, from fuzzy in infancy to specific in early childhood to broad-plus-specific later.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Developmental studies implicate hippocampus and prefrontal regions but conspicuously fail to implicate the sensory cortices and basal ganglia that dominate adult statistical learning findings.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The developmental neuroimaging evidence base is extremely thin, resting on a single infant functional imaging study.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Overall the review concludes that the two domains follow different trajectories and that this divergence appears only on direct measures.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
